shortDescription: China's Shenzhen Longsys Electronics SZSE:301308 is seeking to raise up to HK$6.27 billion ($799.80 million) through a Hong Kong listing, according to an exchange filing on Monday.Here are some details:($1 = 7.8395 Hong Kong dollars)

children: is seeking to raise up to HK$6.27 billion ($799.80 million) through a Hong Kong listing, according to an exchange filing on Monday.
The Shenzhen-listed semiconductor company is offering a total number of 26.1 million H shares at a maximum offer price of HK$240.60 per share.
The company plans to finalise the offer price on September 4, with allocation results to be announced by September 7.
The firm's H shares are expected to begin trading on September 8.
The company reported year-on-year growth of more than 71,000% in its half-year net profit released this month.

It plans to use around 78.3% of the net proceeds from the share sale to enhance its independent research and development and innovation capabilities in key areas including chip design and advanced memory product development.
